stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: Alert SID 9000001 triggered: TCP SYN from WEB zone (10.1.100.10) to DB-OLTP zone (10.1.200.10) on PostgreSQL port 5432. This is a hard microsegmentation violation per the policy matrix — WEB→DB-OLTP is explicitly DENY.
Baseline verification: No production baseline exists for WEB→DB-OLTP flows. The only legitimate WEB outbound is web-to-appgw-proxy (10.1.100.10 → 10.3.100.10:8080). This flow is anomalous.

Source reputation analysis: web-01 has trust score 0.37 and runtime reputation 0.00 (very_low) with 12 true positives in the last hour. This is a REPEAT OFFENDER with 20 prior SID 9000001 violations in 90 days, all enforced as DROP.

Past incident pattern: Agent enforced DROP on 20/20 exact-SID matches with confidence 0.95. Recent decisions (2026-06-02) show consistent enforcement. Semantic similarity and MITRE T1021 matches all resulted in DROP.
Multi-alert correlation: 5-alert sequence (SIDs 9000001, 9000001, 9000901, 9000905, 9000002) indicates kill-chain progression — lateral movement attempts across multiple violation types.

Blast radius assessment: Full-source block would break critical web-to-appgw-proxy flow. Targeted block (src+dst+port) preserves legitimate traffic while stopping the violation. Recommended and implemented: targeted DROP.
MITRE mapping: TA0008 Lateral Movement / T1021 Remote Services — attacker attempting to move from Internet-exposed WEB tier to crown-jewel DB-OLTP tier, bypassing application-layer controls.

Confidence calibration: Total severity points = 4 (cross_zone_policy_violation) + 2 (source_in_sensitive_zone) + 1 (dst_port_in_critical_db_set) + 1 (corroborated_by_past_incidents) + 2 (matches_known_chain_stage) = 10 points → P1. Confidence 0.95 aligns with 'total_points_>=8_with_unambiguous_signals' bracket.

hypotheses.name: microsegmentation_bypass_lateral_movement
hypotheses.description: microsegmentation_bypass_lateral_movement (probability=0.95) — WEB host web-01 directly accessing DB-OLTP on PostgreSQL port, bypassing the required WEB→APP-GW→APP-CORE→DB chain. Evidence: SID 9000001 trigger, policy matrix DENY, no baseline match, repeat offender with 20 prior exact-SID violations. Counter: None — this is a hard policy violation with zero legitimate use case.

hypotheses.name: misconfigured_monitoring_tool
hypotheses.description: misconfigured_monitoring_tool (probability=0.03) — Monitoring or health-check tool misconfigured to probe DB directly from WEB tier. Evidence: None in alert context. Counter: No baseline entry for such monitoring; legitimate monitoring flows originate from MONITORING zone, not WEB.

hypotheses.name: compromised_web_server_c2_beacon
hypotheses.description: compromised_web_server_c2_beacon (probability=0.02) — web-01 compromised and establishing C2 channel to DB port as evasion technique. Evidence: Multi-SID correlation (9000001, 9000901, 9000905, 9000002) suggests kill-chain progression. Counter: DB port 5432 is atypical for C2; more likely lateral movement attempt.

Watch for DB-OLTP outbound anomalies (SID 9000009, 9000062) indicating potential data exfiltration if lateral movement succeeded before block.
